title: Updating a local variable
statement: Let $W$ be a word size, let $Z$ specify a layout with $F$ local variables per frame, and suppose $m$ satisfies the storage relation for a state $\sigma$ and frame pointer $q$. If $1\le q$, then for any local index $x$ and integer value $v$, the state obtained from $\sigma$ by replacing its $x$th local value with $v$, together with the memory map obtained from $m$ by replacing the value at stack address $q+x$ with the encoding of $v$, satisfies the same storage relation at frame pointer $q$.
